Archaeological Museum of Chania.question: The museum has a Roman floor mosaic, depicting _____ and Ariadne
Archaeological Museum of Chania.fact: The museum has a Roman floor mosaic, depicting Dionysos and Ariadne.

Archaeological Museum of Chania.subject: Environment & Ecology
Archaeological Museum of Chania.question: There is also a spherical flask, noted for its unusual ceramic type, dated to the _____ III period
Archaeological Museum of Chania.fact: The Archaeological Museum of Chania also has an ancient Cycladic style vessel from Episkopi, Kissamos and a number of busts including one of Roman emperor Hadrian, found at the Dictynaion sanctuary in 1913 and a late Minoan sarcophagus from the necropolis of Armeni, dated to 1400–1200 BC. There is also a spherical flask, noted for its unusual ceramic type, dated to the Late Minoan III period.

Archaeological Museum of Sitia.fact: The Archaeological Museum of Sitia is a museum in Sitia of Crete, in Greece.

Archaeological Museum of Sitia.question: Its collection consists of _____-era finds from Sitia, Zakros, Petra and Palaikastro
Archaeological Museum of Sitia.fact: Its collection consists of Minoan-era finds from Sitia, Zakros, Petra and Palaikastro.
